message.content:
An editorial magazine cover on a light-brown, textured background features a large illustration of a man’s head and neck in the center. The illustration, in black, white, and shades of green, shows a man with dark sunglasses and a wide, grinning expression that reveals his teeth. He wears a green beret with a white emblem on the front. Above the illustration, the word "TEMPO" is written in large, dark-green capital letters. Below the illustration is the text "EDISI KHUSUS" inside a rectangular border, and underneath that, "RAHASIA-RAHASIA ALI MOERTOPO" in large, black, sans-serif capitals. 

In the top left corner, a small photo of a woman wearing a grey hijab and a black jacket is placed inside a black horizontal bar. To her right, the text "POLITIK BISNIS RATU ATUT HALAMAN 116" is visible in white. A white bar with a barcode and price information, "RP 35.000", is on the right side. The entire image is framed by a thin, distressed black border. Vertical text on the far-left edge reads "TEMPO | RAHASIA-RAHASIA ALI MOERTOPO". The date "EDISI 14-20 OKTOBER 2013" is printed in small letters below the main title.
